name: Thomas Hamilton
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
notes: Brother of Elizabeth (Eliza) Hamilton; Jose Pierre Adams, his brother-in-law, administered his estate (final account May 1836).
His will (written 1830) was executed by his brother-in-law Jose P. Adams in 1836; it names George as minor son of Jose P. Adams [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, line 3999]
Received from his uncle the remainder of the slaves held by his brother John Alexander [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, line 9655]
Estate appraisal named Jose P. and William ADAMS; final account filed May 1836 by the administrator Jose P. ADAMS, his brother-in-law [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, line 9657]
Named as Uncle in the will of Francis A. HAMILTON [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, line 9695]
